svg.title: QR exchange and customer authorization - actual flow

g.text: QR exchange and customer authorization - actual flow
capture hash on each navigation; replace URL immediately
different tokens serialized; stale results ignored.
Production must enforce HTTPS/Secure. Raw credential never stored in DB.
customer DTO; no QR token or price snapshot
Reusing A ->404. Multiple devices scan successive rotated QR codes.
Close deletes grants, so old cookie ->401.
New invalid QR must show error without falling back to old session.
